newEntriesNeeded.title: SetDate of dbref — extract date from STAMP
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Use SetDate of dbref to extract a date value from a STAMP element.
pitfalls: STAMP must be a valid dbref; otherwise SetDate returns UNSET

newEntriesNeeded.title: OLD attribute qualifier for deleted element values
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Use OLD qualifier to retrieve the value of an attribute before an element was deleted.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_03
if (!action eq |DELETE|) then
  !evaluate = |var !val OLD $!expression of $!tag|
endif
$!<evaluate>
pitfalls: OLD qualifier only works for deleted elements; using it on existing elements may fail
Must use dynamic $! evaluation to pass attribute name at runtime

newEntriesNeeded.title: SETCOMPDATE command — set database comparison date
newEntriesNeeded.principle: SETCOMPDATE sets the comparison date for database queries, enabling delta detection.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_03
var !stampDate SetDate of $!latestStamp
SETCOMPDATE FOR DB $!dbName to $!stampDate
pitfalls: Must set comparison date before collecting modified/deleted/created elements
Date must be a valid STAMP date

newEntriesNeeded.title: PMLTAGS object and GetListDefinition method
newEntriesNeeded.principle: PMLTAGS is a system object providing access to tag list definitions and database views.
pitfalls: Category name must match exactly; case-sensitive
List name must exist in the specified category

newEntriesNeeded.title: NetDataSource .NET object for grid data binding
newEntriesNeeded.principle: NetDataSource creates a .NET data source from PML arrays for binding to grid controls.
newEntriesNeeded.syntax: NetDataSource(STRING name, ARRAY headers, ARRAY data)
pitfalls: headers must be ARRAY of STRING
data must be ARRAY of ARRAY (rows)

newEntriesNeeded.title: NETGRIDCONTROL saveGridToExcel method
newEntriesNeeded.principle: NETGRIDCONTROL.saveGridToExcel exports the bound grid to an Excel file.
newEntriesNeeded.syntax: saveGridToExcel(STRING path, STRING format, STRING description)
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_03
!dataTable.saveGridToExcel('|$!publishPath$!dataFileName|', |data|, |Export delta. Author: $!<userName> Date: $!<startDateTime> Comparison Date: $!<stampDate>|)
pitfalls: Format parameter determines Excel export format

newEntriesNeeded.title: elsehandle none — empty elsehandle as no-op
newEntriesNeeded.principle: elsehandle none is a valid empty handler that explicitly marks a block with no error recovery.
newEntriesNeeded.rule:
handle any
  -- error handling code
elsehandle none
  -- success path, no error handler needed
endhandle
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_03
$!<evaluate>
handle any
  !rowDataList.append(!!error.text)
elsehandle none
  !rowDataList.append(!val)
endhandle
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern:
handle any
  -- nothing
endhandle  -- missing elsehandle; implicit no-op but less explicit
pitfalls: elsehandle none is optional; omitting it is equivalent but less explicit
Do not confuse with missing elsehandle entirely in nested blocks

newEntriesNeeded.title: ARRAY.findFirst().set() pattern for membership testing
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Use findFirst() combined with .set() to test whether a value exists in an array.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_03
if (!deletedTags.findfirst(!tag).set()) then
  !action = |DELETE|
elsif (!createdTags.findfirst(!tag).set()) then
  !action = |NEW|
endif
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: if (!deletedTags.findFirst(!tag) neq UNSET) then  -- less idiomatic
pitfalls: findFirst returns UNSET if not found; .set() checks for valid result
Must use lowercase findfirst in some PML versions; check case sensitivity
